title: Silicon Power Architect, Reality Labs
description:

Reality Labs Silicon team is driving the driving the industry forward with innovative work in AI, augmented reality, computer vision, machine learning, graphics, displays, and sensors. Our chips will enable wearable devices where our real and virtual worlds will mix and match throughout the day. We believe the only way to achieve our goals is to look at the entire stack, from transistors, through architecture, firmware, and algorithms. We are seeking a Silicon Power Architect to lead the development of next\-generation silicon solutions for wearables. * Understand the tradeoffs between general\-purpose and custom compute mechanisms, be able to model data flows, and create detailed cost/benefit analysis
* Work on post silicon model to hardware correlation
